[firmware/controllers/algo/airmass_loads.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/algo/airmass_loads.cpp): Captured consumer coordinates are resolved after fuel publication and invalidated by tune generation changes.

last_sync.summary: Human-reviewed manual recovery audit for SD and Alpha-N air-mass blending. Source evidence is pinned at [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md); guide target for a separate docs PR: docs/08-Fuel/Fuel-Algorithms/Blended.md, docs/02-Intro-Start-Here/09-Which-Fuel-Method-For-Me.md (not claimed public here). The ledger limits the integration merge to the audited original.

decisions.rationale: Adds an SD + Alpha-N strategy using a TPS or measured-MAP authority table, branch fallback and new diagnostics, with layout 20031 manual transfer and breakpoint re-entry needs.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): Adds an SD + Alpha-N authority table with selectable TPS or measured-MAP axes and manual calibration transfer.

[firmware/controllers/algo/airmass/blended_airmass.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/algo/airmass/blended_airmass.cpp): The model combines raw branch masses, applies shared corrections once and records branch fallback.

[firmware/tunerstudio/tunerstudio.template.ini](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/tunerstudio/tunerstudio.template.ini): Fuel strategy includes SD + Alpha-N and exposes the authority Y-axis and blend table.
